title: Scratch's Ball
summary: Keep the ball in inventory to summon Scratch or throw it to play fetch.

fields.Summon: Use Find Familiar: Scratch once per Short Rest. Keep the ball directly in the summoner’s inventory, outside other containers.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. In camp or while Scratch can reach it, he returns it. Otherwise the throw auto-casts Find Familiar: Scratch if available.
fields.Acquisition: Get it from Scratch in camp with Strength, Sleight of Hand or Animal Handling, or ask with Speak with Animals. Return to Scratch if lost.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
